name: delay_slapback_guitar
description: Slapback echo on guitar — classic Sun Studios / rockabilly character
notes: 100ms single echo at mix 0.3. LP at 6kHz matches the frequency response of tape echo units (Echoplex, RE-201). No feedback keeps it tight. Works on both clean and lightly driven guitar. For a more modern double-tracked feel, try 20-30ms at mix 0.5 instead.
